sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:145648
Court No. - 77
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 24183 of 2023

Applicant :- Ashish Kumar
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Satish Sharma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Alok Tiwari,Anand Tiwari
Hon'ble Mrs. Jyotsna Sharma,J.
01.
Heard Shri Satish Sharma, learned counsel for applicant, Sri Anand Tiwari, learned counsel for the first informant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

02. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant seeking bail in case crime no.0006 of 2023, under Sections 411, 413, 414, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B I.P.C. and Section 3/25 Arms Act,
P.S.George Town,District Prayagraj.
03.

As per version of the F.I.R., certain accused persons were arrested and from their possession a number of stolen property including the mobiles, scooty, pulser motorcycle, two laptops etc. were recovered.

04. It is contended on behalf of the applicant that from the possession of the present applicant three mobiles, cash and illegal firearm were allegedly recovered and there is nothing on record to suggest that they were stolen articles connected to a case of theft.

It is further contended that the assertions in the recovery memo that the applicant was involved in certain incidents of theft etc. are artificial Ashish Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83409277/
1 one; moreover such statements do not have any legal value and same shall be treated as statements of the accused given before the police; the applicant is in custody since 07.01.2023 i.e. since last six months.

entities.text: Ashish Kumar vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As far as criminal history of the applicant is concerned, same has been suitably explained in para-9 of the affidavit filed in support of the application; certain bail orders have been placed before this court.
05. The application for bail is opposed by learned A.G.A.
However, certain aspects of the matter could not be refuted by learned A.G.A.
06. I considered nature of the allegations, role ascribed to the applicant, the evidence proposed, the severity of punishment and all other facts and circumstances of the case.
In my view, a case for bail is made out.

07. Let applicant - Ashish Kumar be released on bail in the aforesaid Case Crime Number on his furnishing personal bond and two reliable sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
(ii) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed, either personally or through his counsel.
(iii) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (i) framing of charge and (ii) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C. without exception.
08. Any violation of above conditions will be treated as misuse of bail and learned Court below will be at liberty to pass appropriate order.

Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Asha  Ashish Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83409277/
